lyricsSource: Poolside Chill Reimagined workbook (Song Pack, col D)
lyrics:
[Intro: piano chords, soft shaker, distant surf]

[Vocal: bright female voice, one phrase]
Play it till the tide turns
Play it till the light goes

[Build: kick enters, piano rising]
Play it, play it

[Drop: joyful saxophone melody, full beat]

[Vocal: female voice, a little closer]
Nobody knows your name down here
Play it till the tide turns

[Build: snare roll, handclaps]
Play it, play it

[Drop: saxophone melody, higher, with strings]

[Break: saxophone alone, free time]

[Final Drop: saxophone and voice together]
Play it till the tide turns
Play it till the light goes

[Outro: last saxophone note, applause from balconies]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 124 BPM, 4/4, G major. Bright, bouncing and joyful melodic house led by a horn.

VOICE: Female, bright and clear, singing only two short phrases, slightly pleading and smiling. She sings along with the saxophone in the final drop. No verses.

INSTRUMENTS: A tenor saxophone playing a strong, singable melody, bright piano chords, a light four-on-the-floor kick with an off-beat open hi-hat, a bouncing bass, shakers, handclaps, a string section in the second drop, surf and distant applause.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, piano and surf. 0:14 First vocal. 0:30 Build. 0:44 Drop 1, saxophone. 1:16 Second vocal. 1:32 Build. 1:44 Drop 2, with strings. 2:16 Break, saxophone alone. 2:28 Final drop, sax and voice. 2:50 Outro, last note and applause, ends 2:58.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 2013 melodic deep house: clean and sunny, saxophone recorded close and warm, piano bright, drums light.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The saxophone entering at 0:44.

STATION FIT: 6:15 p.m., early golden hour. The pack's most openly happy track and nearly an instrumental, which makes it easy to place anywhere.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Listening, lifted, dancing, applauding.
